orchestration_result.query: Build me a laddered bond portfolio for a 5-year horizon using investment-grade securities only.

bonds.analysis: To build a laddered bond portfolio with a 5-year horizon using only investment-grade securities, we will allocate funds across bonds maturing in each of the next 5 years. This approach helps to provide a steady stream of cash flows while managing interest rate risk and credit risk. Each maturity bucket will be allocated 20% of the portfolio, ensuring that no more than 30% of the portfolio is concentrated in any single year. The average credit rating of the portfolio will remain high, with a focus on BBB+ or better, and the overall portfolio duration will be kept below 7 years to avoid excessive interest rate sensitivity. Given the 5-year horizon and the 20% allocation per year, the resulting portfolio duration is expected to be around 2.5 years, well within our constraints.

orchestration_result.final_recommendation: Allocate 20% to US Treasury Bond 1-year, 20% to US Corporate Bond 2-year, 20% to US Municipal Bond 3-year, 20% to US Agency Bond 4-year, and 20% to US Corporate Bond 5-year, ensuring a laddered bond portfolio with a 5-year horizon and investment-grade securities only, with an overall portfolio duration of 2.5 years.
